subTitle: Common questions about our corrugated boxes and how we work.

faqs.question: What is your minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Our published price list starts at the smallest quantity tier (up to 119 pcs per size). Larger volumes get better prices. If you need a different quantity, send an enquiry and we will quote it.

faqs.question: Can I get a sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom samples cost €100 including air freight. The €100 is deducted from your order total once you place a production order.

faqs.question: Which trade terms do you support?
faqs.answer: We can work on EXW, FOB, CIF and DDP terms. If you have your own forwarder in China we quote ex-works; otherwise we can quote a delivered price including freight.

faqs.question: How are the goods shipped?
faqs.answer: Samples are mainly sent by air. Bulk orders are mainly shipped by the China-Europe Railway Express.

faqs.question: What paper grades and flute types do you use?
faqs.answer: We use kraft and test liner from 90 to 180 g/m². 3-ply boxes are available in B, C and E flute; 5-ply in BC and BE; 7-ply in BAB, BAA, CAC and BAC combinations.

faqs.question: Can you print our logo on the boxes?
faqs.answer: Yes — 1–4 colour flexo printing is available on every box type. Send your artwork in AI, PDF or CDR format and we will confirm the print layout before production.

faqs.question: What are your payment terms?
faqs.answer: Payment terms are agreed per order. Tell us your preferred terms in the enquiry and we will confirm what we can support.
